units.source_text: 壁顶的一边，画了飞天弹琵琶和吹笛子，另一边画出了手持白牡丹振翅飞翔的迦陵频枷。

en.t: On one side of the top of the wall, celestial beings were painted playing the biwa and blowing flutes, while on the other side was painted a kalavinka, holding a white peony and flying with its wings outspread.

units.source_text: 它是栖息在天竺雪山的妙音鸟，上半身呈丰满的女子的姿态，下半身成鸟。

en.t: It was the wondrous-voiced bird said to dwell in the snowy mountains of India, with the full upper body of a woman and the lower body of a bird.

units.source_text: 另外，壁顶中央画了一只凤凰，

en.t: In addition, a phoenix was painted at the center of the top of the wall,

units.source_text: 与金阁顶上的鸟是友鸟，但与那只威严的金鸟毫无相似之处，却像是华丽的彩虹。

en.t: and although it was a companion bird to the one on the roof of the Golden Pavilion, it bore no resemblance at all to that majestic golden bird, but was instead like a splendid rainbow.
